names: Alexandria Center for Science and Technology – 1450 Owens
summary: 1450 Owens Street is a 7-story, ~215,000 sq ft laboratory/office building (133,000 sq ft lab, ~50,000 sq ft office, 2,600 sq ft ground-floor retail) at the Alexandria Center for Science and Technology's Mission Bay Megacampus, developed by Alexandria Real Estate Equities. The building came online in 2024; in March 2026 Gladstone Institutes announced a long-term lease of more than 105,000 sq ft as its anchor tenant, with about 20 labs opening there in early 2027.

milestones.text: New building permits issued for the 7-story lab/office building (August 2021, per San Francisco YIMBY); construction estimated at ~$70 million. The source dates the permit, not the start of construction.
Construction topped out on the seven-story structure (reported by San Francisco YIMBY in February 2023; exact topping-out date not stated).

Gladstone Institutes announced it had secured 105,000+ sq ft of laboratory space in the building (about 20 labs for its data science and genomic immunology institutes), with move-in expected in early 2027; Alexandria's executive chairman called Gladstone the anchor tenant.
Fire sprinkler water service permit (202209061935, filed September 2022 and issued September 13, 2022) reached complete status.
DBI new-construction permit 202012281760 (7-story warm shell and core) reached 'complete' status.
First construction document issued under permit 202012281760.
OTC alterations permit (202112063791) issued for a test section of planned stone column ground improvements at the site.
Over-the-counter alterations permit issued for a pile load test program for augered cast-in-place piles supporting the planned 7-story shell-and-core office/lab building (filed 2021-12-21).
Grading permit (202107194655) issued for site grading in support of the planned 7-story shell & core lab/office high rise; filed July 19, 2021.
Alterations permit 202306018964 filed and issued on 2023-06-01 for 31 evacuation plan maps covering floors 1-7 and the penthouse, for fire review only.
Over-the-counter alterations permit 202306018964 (evacuation plan maps) recorded as complete.
Alterations permit 202403087397 issued for revisions to incorporate final scp changes required by landscape & public art coordination.

open_questions: Exact day of the August 2021 permit issuance is not sourced, only the month.
Exact topping-out date is not sourced; only that it had occurred by the San Francisco YIMBY article's February 2023 publication.
Exact month within 2024 that the building 'came online' is not sourced -- only the year, from Commercial Property Executive's March 2026 coverage.

Corrected 2026-10-06 (accuracy audit, October 2026): the summary dated Gladstone's anchor lease to 2024, the year the building came online. Gladstone announced the lease on March 25, 2026 (labs opening early 2027) and Commercial Property Executive reported it on March 27, 2026; the summary now says so. Changelog row 542 had reported this fixed in September, but the summary had not changed.

permits.description: Over-the-counter alterations permit (202405303298) for new irrigation and a foundation for a public artwork installation, filed May 2024 and issued August 6, 2024, reached 'complete' status.

Permit for installation of a Notifier NFS2-3030 addressable voice fire alarm system in the building's core areas (as-built drawings for the high-rise lab and office construction) reached completed status; filed November 14, 2024 and issued November 20, 2024.
Permit 202407166568 for a 40.2 kW rooftop photovoltaic system completed (filed July 2024, issued September 2024).
OTC alterations permit 202304196000 for main lobby improvements at the main entrance marked complete (issued June 22, 2023).

Building permit issued for interior tenant improvement to build out offices, R&D laboratories and support spaces on levels 1 and 5-7 of the existing 7-story core and shell building (filed January 2026, approved July 10, 2026).
Alterations permit 202608317416 filed for deferred mech and bulletin 1 wall location and ceiling updates for office and support space at levels 1 and 5-7.
